messages:
Maya: Quick idea — for the webinar/demo we should frame a 'speed vs spend' play that isn't just avg latency vs cost. Show tail percentiles, per-session $ estimates, and a demo of graceful fallback. Short, visual, and engineer-friendly. Thoughts?

Leo: Love it. Can we make it two quick panels: (1) percentile latency across variants (p50/p95/p99) and (2) tokens -> $ per session for common prompts. Keep text minimal.

Jamal: +1. Also add a tiny table that shows fallback paths (e.g., full model -> quantized variant -> distilled) with latency and delta-cost columns. Helps Ops and product convos.

Priya: For inbound routing we can tag registrants who explicitly care about latency (or who run big token sessions) and route them to AMs. Suggest SFDC tag: speed_sensitive. @Maya can you define thresholds?

Maya: Draft thresholds proposal: high-touch = >5k tokens/session, medium = 1k-5k, low <1k. Will convert to minutes for sales copy.

MarketingBot: Template created: /assets/speed-spend-2panel-v1.png (auto-upload).

Leo: Copy idea for social/meta: "When tokens add up, speed pays." short and punchy. Maybe test 3 variants: curious, technical, executive.

Priya: Avoid p95 jargon for execs — use 'tail latency' and a tooltip definition. For technical audience we can include p50/p95/p99.

Jamal: For the demo, we should show two live scenarios: (A) latency-sensitive customer (low token but strict SLA) and (B) throughput customer (long sessions). Show cost math live. Need macros to compute tokens->$ on the fly. I'll build those.

Maya: Webinar run: 10m context, 15m live demo (two scenarios), 10m Q&A. Live demo = show fallback to cheaper variant and the visible change in latency/cost.

Leo: I'll volunteer to run the demo. Need a reproducible script and a rollback (quick way to stop streaming or switch model if something fails).

Maya: Action items (quick):
- Maya: upload sketch + 3 CTA variants by EOD.
- Leo: demo script + rollback steps by Thu.
- Jamal: cost-calc macros + token->minute helpers.
- Priya: inbound gating rule & SFDC tag spec.

Priya: Q — what do we treat as a high-touch registration? Is 5k tokens too high?

Jamal: 5k is a safe default for product demos; we can allow sales to flag exceptions. We'll also expose an estimate like "~X minutes of LLM time" for less jargon.

Maya: For positioning: emphasize predictable economics and graceful degradation. Avoid deep infra-speak in marketing copy; keep those details for the appendix slide.

Leo: I'll mock the demo runbook and post it in #docs. Will include command snippets and a short fallback checklist.

Priya: I'll draft the inbound flow diagram once Jamal shares the thresholds. Also will sketch the gating logic for MQL -> AM.

Maya: Thanks team — let's keep social posts to one-liners and test them across three cohorts. Small experiments, quick learn. :rocket:

Leo: Will share the first mock by tomorrow.

Jamal: Working on macros now, will post a gist.

Maya: Great — appreciate it. :thumbsup:
